verdict.rationale: Render is a cloud application platform that runs full services, including Docker containers (render-docs-2), and offers TypeScript workflow tasks (render-docs-22, render-docs-5). This implies a full, unrestricted Node.js runtime rather than a restricted edge subset. However, nothing documents an edge or serverless function product, or explicitly confirms unmodified Node.js/npm compatibility in function-style compute. Missing for 10: an edge/serverless function offering, explicit docs on full Node.js/npm compatibility in that runtime, independent or hands-on corroboration.
